page.overview:
Who is Demi-God?

Demi-God is one of the superheroes mentioned by Mark in the third episode of Season 1. He is seen attempting to tryout for the New Guardians of the Globe.

Demi-God appears as a floating purple head which seems to be his entire body, or a form of it. He wears a gray sweater vest over a white shirt with a blue tie and black gloves along with gray pants and brown shoes.

Demi-God wields a metal staff with a floating purple orb at the tip.

Demi-God was one of the many superheroes present during tryouts for the Guardians of the Globe, though he was not one of the heroes selected to join the new group in the end.
